bio.text: Ceci Maher has represented Connecticut's 26th Senate District since January 2023; on March 5, 2026, she announced she would not run for re-election.
As of 2023 she lived in Wilton.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Amherst and a master's degree in social work from Columbia University in 1999.
Her career includes work as interim executive director of Sandy Hook Promise, CEO of Person-to-Person and a social worker.
